slots.title: Consumer confidence 89.4, below 90.3 estimate
slots.body:
August US consumer confidence: **89.4**.

Consensus was **90.3**; July was **90.2**.

That print landed the same session major US indexes finished higher and the fear gauge eased.

- $SPY proxy: S&P 500 **+0.3%** to **7,675.83**
- Nasdaq Composite **+0.7%** to **26,151.30**
- $VIX **−2.5%** to **15.46**

The survey measures how households feel about jobs and spending — a soft read next to the estimate, with stocks still closing up on the day.

What do you watch first when confidence slips but indexes don’t?

slots.title: July new home sales 0.61M, under 0.62M est
slots.body:
July **new home sales**: **0.61M** (0.607M in the release).

Economists looked for **0.62M**; June was **0.68M**.

Same day, **building permits** for July: **1.43M** vs **1.44M** expected.

Permits rose **+4.3%** month over month vs a **+5.0%** forecast — permits are an early read on future construction.

Together, sales down from June and permits a touch light vs estimates.

How much housing data do you stack against confidence prints like August’s **89.4**?

slots.title: Aug. 25 US cash session recap
slots.body:
The S&P 500 rose 0.3% to 7,675.83 (+22.97 points).
The Nasdaq Composite gained 0.7% to 26,151.30 (+171.11).
The Dow added 0.3% to 53,577.40 (+160.24).
The Russell 2000 finished up 0.5% at 3,010.02.

The CBOE Volatility Index closed at 15.46, down 2.5% from 15.85, with an intraday range of 15.13 to 16.30.

At 2:00 p.m.
ET, the Conference Board’s consumer-confidence reading for August printed at 89.4, below the 90.3 estimate and down from 90.2 prior.
New home sales for July were 0.607M units vs 0.62M expected and 0.678M previously.

Building permits for July were 1.433M vs 1.443M estimated; permits rose 4.3% month over month vs a 5.0% estimate.

Real Estate led Nasdaq sector averages at +1.7%.
Utilities averaged +0.8%.
Financial Services averaged +0.6%.
Healthcare averaged +0.4%.
Energy averaged -1.0%.
Consumer Defensive averaged -0.6%.
Technology was roughly flat at 0.0%.

$DKS fell 30.7% to $124.31 after EPS of $3.53 missed the $3.75 estimate and revenue of $5.59B trailed the ~$5.64B forecast; volume was 38.6M shares and the low tagged $124.00.

$INTU dropped 3.4% to $357.46 despite EPS $4.03 vs $3.58 est and revenue beat; $ZM fell 3.7% to $100.92 with an EPS beat; $SMTC rose 5.5% to $127.52 on a beat.

Megacap tech mixed to higher:

- $GOOGL -0.3% to 346.96

- $CVX -1.6% to 199.90

Gold futures settled at $4,693.30 (0.0%).
